purpose: GW001 counts by actual competition descriptors
sql: SELECT source,competition_group,sm_action,sm_country,sm_division,SUM(n) AS n FROM (SELECT 'Results' source,competition_group,sm_action,sm_country,sm_division,COUNT(*) n FROM `GW001_IMC Results` GROUP BY competition_group,sm_action,sm_country,sm_division UNION ALL SELECT 'Match Report' source,competition_group,sm_action,sm_country,sm_division,COUNT(*) n FROM `GW001_IMC Match Report` GROUP BY competition_group,sm_action,sm_country,sm_division) x GROUP BY source,competition_group,sm_action,sm_country,sm_division ORDER BY competition_group,sm_action,sm_country,sm_division,source
